result_text:
Promotions now carry an optional description, and it comes back from all six listing and lookup methods. The 26 promotion-related tests pass (`PromotionTest`, `PriceListTest`, `OrderPromotionTest`, `PromotionUsageTest`, `PromotionsPerRegionTest`, `PromotionsPerCustomerTest`). I did not run the full suite. Nothing is committed.

What changed:

- **`schema.sql`**: new nullable `description VARCHAR(255)` column on `promotion`. Existing rows get no description.
- **`model/Promotion.java`**: `description` added as the last record component, documented as null when none was given.
- **`DataStore.java`**: `createPromotion` writes the description. `findPromotionByCode`, `listPromotionsActiveOn`, `listPromotionsActiveOnInRegion`, `listPromotionsByCategory`, `findBestPromotion` and `listUnusedPromotions` select the column and map it.
- **`service/PromotionService.java`** (outside the three files you named): the description has to be entered somewhere, so I added a six-argument `createPromotion` overload. Blank text is stored as null. The existing five-argument method delegates to it with null, so existing callers and tests are unchanged.
- **`PromotionTest.java`**: one new test. It creates SUMMER with a description and checks the text comes back from the active, category and region listings. It also checks a promotion without one shows null.
